title: RAW UNREVIEWED: product words encode material-plus-process genealogy and constrain a later named return
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Hypothesize a finite procedural word code in which a material part and a shared operation part generate the denotation of a product nominal. The same constructor works in an isolated label and as a prose argument. A later preparation must resolve its patient from that generated product type, so changing a written material or process contribution changes both the output definition and the later continuation. This differs from assigning independent whole-word product values and then manually assigning their event roles. Already owned Vitruvius VII.12 supplies a concrete two-material/shared-process/selective-return prior, not a manuscript binding or source identification.

design.mechanism: Procedural abbreviation of product genealogy: a globally fixed material constructor and process constructor compose to a product-type expression. A compositional nominalization makes the same expression a label or clause argument. Later operations accept the type derived by that writing law, not an unrelated whole-word lookup or externally supplied event-role annotation.
design.unit: Complete owned historical prior: Vitruvius De architectura VII.12 paragraphs1–2, Morgan1914 English translation. Prospective Voynich target and second complete consumer remain unassigned.

finite_example.historical_naming: The historical source calls these white lead and verdigris/aeruca, respectively. These are source names, not assigned Voynich words.
finite_example.later_input: Explicit source white-lead subject resolves to PRODUCT(JAR_TREATMENT, LEAD), although the copper/verdigris branch intervenes.
finite_example.next_output: PRODUCT(OVEN_HEAT, PRODUCT(JAR_TREATMENT, LEAD)) corresponds to the source artificial sandarach. This recursively formed type is a paid prospective writing hypothesis, not the demonstrated morphology of any historical name.

shared_writing_law: Choose one finite, native-reading segmentation and one global order/attachment law before whole-account authoring; formal direction and whole-form residuals remain constraints. The 98 learned units are not assumed to be an alphabet.

The same admitted material part contributes the same input type wherever it participates in the focal constructor; the same process part contributes the same operation definition. No target qok, che, dy, ar, aN or other part is assigned here.
A product nominal is compositionally generated from those contributions. It cannot be independently redefined as whichever output closes a later clause.
Nominalization/reference and clause argument placement are explicit global paid rules. Event patient/operation roles must follow the written rule rather than separate occurrence-specific annotations.

The same nominal expression denotes one product type in a caption or prose. Individual batch introduction and anaphoric coidentity require separate declared rules; repeated type does not force identical physical material.
changed_falsifier: After target, segmentation, primitive senses, nominalization and clause rules are frozen, two product expressions under the same process must derive the two different input-dependent types from their actual written contributions. A fresh whole-word alias cannot supply a missing material distinction.

A later complete written operation must select the product type derived by its patient expression. A latest-product-only rival selects the copper branch in the source pattern; a generated explicit lead-product nominal selects the earlier lead branch. Both rivals use the same frozen material/process values.

If any focal product or later patient needs a per-word product-name exception, changed process sense, manually donated role, silent type cast or clause-specific reference repair, this particular generative contract fails.

If the proposed written expressions have no discriminating compositional relation or no resolved consumer, the outcome is missing construction/binding, not a meaning test. No source-only graph replay substitutes for the missing target.
design.required_new_input: One prospectively nominated, complete already-admitted Voynich account whose actual written forms supply a two-input/common-process product family and a later product patient, plus one whole nonseed label or passage consuming the same product constructor. Freeze its complete raw fields and the shared role/word rules before assigning historical metal names. No candidate occurrence or metal/product word is invented in this raw proposal.
design.external_meaning_input: Historical text supplies material-varying outcomes under an explicitly shared method and an explicit earlier named-type return. It does not supply target signs, segmentation, words, labels, clause roles, a copy relationship or transparent ancient/medieval product-name morphology.
design.decision_changing_output: A successfully frozen complete construction would leave a restricted material/process family whose returned meaning constrains a later written action, rather than merely executing a freely supplied story. A failed focal composition rejects this contract; an unresolved target remains unselected. Even a coherent C0 result is not confirmed translation.

source_evidence.quote:
CHAPTER XII
WHITE LEAD, VERDIGRIS, AND ARTIFICIAL SANDARACH
1. It is now in place to describe the preparation of white lead and of
verdigris, which with us is called "aeruca." In Rhodes they put shavings
in jars, pour vinegar over them, and lay pieces of lead on the shavings;
then they cover the jars with lids to prevent evaporation. After a
definite time they open them, and find that the pieces of lead have
become white lead. In the same way they put in plates of copper and make
verdigris, which is called "aeruca."
2. White lead on being heated in an oven changes its colour on the fire,
and becomes sandarach. This was discovered as the result of an
accidental fire. It is much more serviceable than the natural sandarach
dug up in mines.

assumptions_and_limits: Material/process encoding and nominalization are new paid C0 hypotheses, not observations. No confirmed English words are required for exploratory authoring.
Only the same-way relation is explicit in the copper branch; copying all jar steps is an ellipsis interpretation. Exact durations, quantities, vessels or batch identities are not supplied.
White-lead oven continuation is explicit. Absence of a verdigris oven clause here does not mean verdigris cannot be heated.
The source names opaque products; it does not establish source-side morphological decomposition or validate modern chemistry.
Both caption and prose use under one word law are proposed, not witnessed target relations. No whole folio, labels or target geometry are donated.
Source pattern alone remains underdetermined under free naming. The new contract earns a constraint only if actual target composition and a complete consumer are prospectively bound.
